explained.why: Comment, not code: line 9 is the file's doc comment showing how others import it (`import { ... } from '../h2/harness/harness.mjs'`); the crawl reads imports from code only (Julian, Q-023).

Configuration: CMakeLists.txt lines 106-111 embed gui.html only with -DHYPERSAW_GUI2=OFF; the declared Release configuration the crawl ran embeds gui2.html, which the crawl has (gui2.html generates gui_html.h, as input). The probe does not read CMake conditions.

Missed by the crawl, a real use: line 133 lists "CMakeLists.txt" among glob patterns the check scans, and line 306 looks it up by key in the dict of repo files read at lines 132-139. A name used as a pattern and a dict key, not a path the crawl can follow.
Probe error: line 177 writes D / "index.html" with D = ROOT / "docs/design" (line 51), i.e. docs/design/index.html, not the root index.html.
Probe error: line 72 compares a lab file's name with "index.html" inside docs/design (f.parent != D); it names no root file.
Probe error: line 296 writes join(outDir, 'index.html'), a run's output folder, not the root index.html (the crawl's next-to-the-file rule for bare names exists for exactly this case).
Text, not an import: lines 147, 151 and 152 pass the string "import { x } from 'y';..." to unguarded() as test input for the coverage scan; the crawl reads imports from code only (Julian, Q-023).

Text, not an import: line 150's "import '../labharness/sandbox_guard.mjs';..." is a string passed to unguarded() as test input; the crawl reads imports from code only (Julian, Q-023). The crawl's reference edge to the same file (lines 119, 135, 150, 151) is the file names the check copies and compares, not this import.

Probe and crawl both misread line 204: it writes a stub at join(fx, 'tools/registry_decl.py'), inside the scratch fixture fx (defined at line 189), not the repo's file. The probe calls it a write to the repo file; the crawl a reference to it, because a literal with a / resolves from the repo root whatever it is joined onto (a known crawl false positive, recorded in Q-025's trace).
Text, not an import: line 152's import('./own.mjs') is inside a string passed to unguarded() as test input; the crawl reads imports from code only (Julian, Q-023).
